card.name: Spaces and punctuation in citations and captions
card.fires_on: The space or punctuation mark that falls just before a name, year or next phrase in reference lists, credits and figure captions on non-drug web text.

modes.label: Space inside reference or organization names
modes.description: A space after a name word in a bibliographic entry or organization list, before the next word.

modes.label: Citation punctuation
